desc: Derivation/verification: reduction to max connected subset S of {deg_T ≥ 4} with deg_S ≤ 4, answer = 3|S| + 2, leaf-disjointness via cycle argument, k=1 allowed.
Implement the complete solution script (fast I/O, degrees, good-vertex CSR forest, iterative order + parent, reverse-order top-4 DP, output `3*best+2` or `-1`).

Dry-run/verify on samples (8, −1, 11 confirmed by hand: sample 1 good={2,3} adjacent → k=2; sample 2 max deg 3 → −1; sample 3 good={1,5,9} path → k=3) and edge cases (N<5 / N=1 short-circuit to −1; single deg-≥4 vertex → 5; top-4 cap handles high-degree vertices; loop over all components covers disconnected good-forest).
Performance check: O(N) CSR construction, iterative DFS, and reverse-order DP with only flat integer arrays — no recursion, comfortable for N = 2×10⁵.
